firm_data.firm_description: Callahan & Fusco, LLC maintains a steadfast commitment to providing clients with a high level of representation and service, striving to offer creative solutions to complex legal problems. The firm is large enough to provide comprehensive service, yet personal enough to maintain an established reputation for individual client attention.
notable_facts: Commited to continual education of all employees

email.subject: AI for Callahan & Fusco, LLC. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Antonio,

Callahan & Fusco has built something most firms can't maintain: the ability to handle complex civil litigation and construction matters with personal client attention instead of BigLaw bureaucracy. That balance is exactly what drew me to reach out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to the mid-Atlantic. I'd be happy to stop by West Orange on Thursday, April 10 to show how we're helping similar firms compete without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
